<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>National Car Rental – Montreal</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Barlow+Semi+Condensed:wght@600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
  :root{
    --green:#0E8540; --green-dark:#0A6630; --green-deep:#074d24;
    --lime:#7DC242; --lime-light:#9ED65A;
    --white:#fff; --bg:#eef3ee; --card:#fff;
    --text:#1c2b1f; --muted:#6b7d6e; --line:#e3ebe4;
  }
  html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;}
  body{
    font-family:'Barlow',system-ui,sans-serif;
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
    line-height:1.5;
    padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) env(safe-area-inset-right) env(safe-area-inset-bottom) env(safe-area-inset-left);
    min-height:100vh;
  }
  .wrap{
    max-width:680px; margin:0 auto;
    background:var(--card);
    min-height:100vh;
    box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  }

  /* LANG BAR */
  .lang-bar{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:20;
    background:var(--green-deep);
    display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    padding:.55rem 1rem;
  }
  .lang-btn{
    font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;
    font-size:.78rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:1.5px;
    padding:5px 14px; border:none; border-radius:40px; cursor:pointer;
    background:transparent; color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
    transition:all .2s;
  }
  .lang-btn.active{background:var(--lime); color:var(--green-deep);}

  /* HERO */
  .hero{
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--green) 0%,var(--green-dark) 100%);
    padding:2.4rem 1.5rem 2rem; text-align:center; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-60px;right:-60px;width:220px;height:220px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);}
  .hero::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-80px;left:-40px;width:200px;height:200px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(125,194,66,.12);}
  .welcome{
    font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;
    color:rgba(255,255,255,.85); font-weight:600;
    font-size:1rem; letter-spacing:3px; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:1rem;
  }
  .logo-badge{
    background:#fff; display:inline-block; padding:18px 26px; border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18); position:relative; z-index:2;
  }
  .logo-badge img{display:block; width:230px; max-width:62vw; height:auto;}
  .location{
    margin-top:1.1rem; color:#fff; font-weight:600; font-size:1.15rem;
    position:relative; z-index:2;
  }
  .tagline{
    margin-top:.3rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,.8); font-style:italic;
    font-size:.92rem; position:relative; z-index:2;
  }

  /* SECTIONS */
  .section{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .sec-head{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px;
    padding:1.3rem 1.5rem .2rem;
  }
  .sec-icon{
    width:46px;height:46px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:12px;
    background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--green),var(--green-dark));
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(14,133,64,.25);
  }
  .sec-icon svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:#fff;}
  .sec-title{
    font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;
    font-weight:800; font-size:1.35rem; color:var(--green-dark);
    letter-spacing:.3px; line-height:1.1;
  }
  .sec-body{padding:.6rem 1.5rem 1.4rem 1.5rem;}

  /* CONTACT ROWS */
  .row{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:13px;
    padding:.7rem 0; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);
    text-decoration:none; color:var(--text);
    transition:transform .15s;
  }
  .row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .row:active{transform:scale(.985);}
  .row-ic{
    width:38px;height:38px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:10px;
    background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .row-ic svg{width:19px;height:19px;fill:var(--green);}
  .row-tx{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .row-label{font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;}
  .row-val{font-size:1.02rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);word-break:break-word;}
  .row-val.green{color:var(--green-dark);}
  .chev{flex-shrink:0;color:var(--lime);}
  .chev svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:currentColor;}

  /* MAP BUTTONS */
  .addr{
    display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;
    background:var(--bg);border-radius:12px;padding:1rem;margin-bottom:.9rem;
  }
  .addr svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:var(--green);flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px;}
  .addr-tx{font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.4;}
  .map-btns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:9px;}
  @media(max-width:380px){.map-btns{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .map-btn{
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;
    padding:.9rem .4rem;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;
    font-weight:700;font-size:.86rem;border:2px solid var(--line);
    color:var(--text);background:#fff;transition:all .18s;text-align:center;
  }
  .map-btn:active{transform:scale(.96);}
  .map-btn:hover{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--bg);}
  .map-btn img,.map-btn .mi{width:30px;height:30px;display:block;}
  .map-btn .mi{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:8px;font-size:.95rem;color:#fff;font-weight:800;}

  /* INFO TEXT */
  .info-p{font-size:.96rem;color:#374b3a;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:.7rem;}
  .info-p:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
  .highlight{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1f8ec,#e8f4e0);
    border-left:4px solid var(--lime);
    border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:.85rem 1rem;margin-top:.6rem;
    font-size:.95rem;
  }
  .highlight a{color:var(--green-dark);font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;}
  .highlight a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
  .highlight b{color:var(--green-dark);}

  .notice{
    background:#fff8ec;border:1px solid #f3e2bf;border-radius:12px;
    padding:1rem;font-size:.92rem;color:#5c4a25;line-height:1.6;
  }

  /* FOOTER */
  .footer{
    background:var(--green-deep);color:#fff;text-align:center;
    padding:1.6rem 1.5rem;
  }
  .footer .thanks{
    font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;
    font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:.3rem;
  }
  .footer .sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:.85rem;}

  [hidden]{display:none!important;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

  <div class="lang-bar">
    <button class="lang-btn active" id="b-en" onclick="setLang('en')">EN</button>
    <button class="lang-btn" id="b-fr" onclick="setLang('fr')">FR</button>
  </div>

  <div class="hero">
    <div class="welcome" data-en>Welcome to</div>
    <div class="welcome" data-fr hidden>Bienvenue chez</div>
    <div class="logo-badge"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="National Car Rental"></div>
    <div class="location" data-en>Montréal International Airport</div>
    <div class="location" data-fr hidden>Aéroport International de Montréal</div>
    <div class="tagline" data-en>Your satisfaction is our top priority.</div>
    <div class="tagline" data-fr hidden>Votre satisfaction est notre priorité.</div>
  </div>

  <!-- CONTACT -->
  <div class="section">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div class="sec-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6.6 10.8c1.4 2.8 3.8 5.1 6.6 6.6l2.2-2.2c.3-.3.7-.4 1-.2 1.2.4 2.5.6 3.8.6.6 0 1 .4 1 1V20c0 .6-.4 1-1 1C10.6 21 3 13.4 3 4c0-.6.5-1 1-1h3.5c.6 0 1 .4 1 1 0 1.3.2 2.6.6 3.8.1.4 0 .8-.3 1l-2.2 2z"/></svg></div>
      <div>
        <div class="sec-title" data-en>Contact Us</div>
        <div class="sec-title" data-fr hidden>Contactez-nous</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sec-body">
      <a class="row" href="mailto:NationalMontrealQC@nationalcar.ca">
        <div class="row-ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 4H4c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v12c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h16c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V6c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm0 4l-8 5-8-5V6l8 5 8-5v2z"/></svg></div>
        <div class="row-tx">
          <div class="row-label">Email</div>
          <div class="row-val green">NationalMontrealQC@nationalcar.ca</div>
        </div>
        <span class="chev"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></span>
      </a>
            <a class="row" href="mailto:yuladmin@em.ca">
        <div class="row-ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20.5 6c-2.6 1.5-5.2 2-7.5 2S7 7.5 4.5 6L3 8.5C5 10 7.5 10.5 10 10.8V21h2v-4h2v4h2V10.8c2.5-.3 5-1 7-2.3L20.5 6zM12 6c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2s-.9-2-2-2-2 .9-2 2 .9 2 2 2z"/></svg></div>
        <div class="row-tx">
          <div class="row-label" data-en>Lost &amp; Found</div>
          <div class="row-label" data-fr hidden>Objets trouvés</div>
          <div class="row-val green">yuladmin@em.ca</div>
        </div>
        <span class="chev"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></span>
      </a>
      <a class="row" href="tel:+18445564930">
        <div class="row-ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18.9 17.4c-.3 0-3-1-3.5-1.2-.5-.2-.9-.3-1.3.3l-.9 1.1c-.6-.3-1.8-.7-3.2-2-1.1-1-1.9-2.2-2.1-2.6-.2-.4 0-.6.3-.9l.6-.7c.2-.3.3-.5.4-.8.1-.3 0-.6 0-.8 0-.2-.9-2.1-1.2-2.9-.3-.8-.6-.7-.9-.7h-.7c-.3 0-.7.1-1 .5-.4.4-1.4 1.3-1.4 3.2 0 1.9 1.4 3.7 1.6 4 .2.3 2.7 4.1 6.5 5.8 3.2 1.4 3.9 1.1 4.6 1 .7-.1 2.2-.9 2.5-1.8.3-.9.3-1.6.2-1.8-.1-.2-.3-.2-.6-.4z"/></svg></div>
        <div class="row-tx">
          <div class="row-label" data-en>Roadside Assistance</div>
          <div class="row-label" data-fr hidden>Assistance routière</div>
          <div class="row-val green">1-844-556-4930</div>
        </div>
        <span class="chev"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></span>
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- FUEL -->
  <div class="section">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div class="sec-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 3h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2v14h1c.6 0 1-.4 1-1v-6.5c0-.4-.2-.8-.5-1.1L14 9V7l2.5 2.5c.6.6 1 1.5 1 2.3V18c0 1.7-1.3 3-3 3H3V3zm2 2v6h6V5H5z"/></svg></div>
      <div>
        <div class="sec-title" data-en>Fuel Information</div>
        <div class="sec-title" data-fr hidden>Information sur le carburant</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sec-body">
      <p class="info-p" data-en>You will receive your rental vehicle with a full tank of gas. If you have not chosen to pre-purchase fuel, you may return the vehicle without refueling (a rate above pump price will apply), or refuel the vehicle prior to return.</p>
      <p class="info-p" data-fr hidden>Vous recevrez votre véhicule de location avec un plein d'essence. Si vous n'avez pas choisi de pré-payer le carburant, vous pouvez retourner le véhicule sans faire le plein (un tarif supérieur au prix à la pompe s'appliquera), ou faire le plein avant le retour.</p>
      <div class="highlight">
        <span data-en><b>Nearest gas station:</b> Esso – 395 Avenue Dorval <i>(Open 24 hours)</i></span>
        <span data-fr hidden><b>Station-service la plus proche :</b> Esso – 395 Avenue Dorval <i>(Ouvert 24 h)</i></span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- RETURN REMINDER -->
  <div class="section">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div class="sec-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 4V1L8 5l4 4V6c3.3 0 6 2.7 6 6 0 1-.3 2-.7 2.8l1.5 1.5C19.5 15.1 20 13.6 20 12c0-4.4-3.6-8-8-8zm0 14c-3.3 0-6-2.7-6-6 0-1 .3-2 .7-2.8L5.2 7.7C4.5 8.9 4 10.4 4 12c0 4.4 3.6 8 8 8v3l4-4-4-4v3z"/></svg></div>
      <div>
        <div class="sec-title" data-en>Vehicle Return Reminder</div>
        <div class="sec-title" data-fr hidden>Rappel pour le retour du véhicule</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sec-body">
      <p class="info-p" data-en>Please remember to check the vehicle for personal belongings before returning it. If an item is left behind, contact our <b>Lost &amp; Found</b> by email using the address above. Thank you for choosing National — your business is greatly appreciated.</p>
      <p class="info-p" data-fr hidden>N'oubliez pas de vérifier que vous n'avez laissé aucun effet personnel dans le véhicule avant de le retourner. En cas d'oubli, contactez notre service <b>Objets trouvés</b> par courriel à l'adresse ci-dessus. Merci d'avoir choisi National — votre confiance nous est précieuse.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- DIRECTIONS -->
  <div class="section">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div class="sec-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2C8.1 2 5 5.1 5 9c0 5.2 7 13 7 13s7-7.8 7-13c0-3.9-3.1-7-7-7zm0 9.5a2.5 2.5 0 110-5 2.5 2.5 0 010 5z"/></svg></div>
      <div>
        <div class="sec-title" data-en>Directions to Return Your Vehicle</div>
        <div class="sec-title" data-fr hidden>Itinéraire pour le retour du véhicule</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sec-body">
      <div class="addr">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2C8.1 2 5 5.1 5 9c0 5.2 7 13 7 13s7-7.8 7-13c0-3.9-3.1-7-7-7zm0 9.5a2.5 2.5 0 110-5 2.5 2.5 0 010 5z"/></svg>
        <div class="addr-tx">590 Albert de Niverville Blvd,<br>Dorval, Québec, H4Y 1G5, Canada</div>
      </div>
      <div class="map-btns">
        <a class="map-btn" href="https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=590+Albert+de+Niverville+Blvd+Dorval+QC+H4Y+1G5" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
          <span class="mi" style="background:#4285F4;">G</span>
          Google Maps
        </a>
        <a class="map-btn" href="https://waze.com/ul?q=590%20Albert%20de%20Niverville%20Blvd%20Dorval%20QC%20H4Y%201G5&navigate=yes" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
          <span class="mi" style="background:#33CCFF;">W</span>
          Waze
        </a>
        <a class="map-btn" href="https://maps.apple.com/?daddr=590+Albert+de+Niverville+Blvd,+Dorval,+QC+H4Y+1G5&dirflg=d" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
          <span class="mi" style="background:#000;"></span>
          Apple Maps
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TRAFFIC NOTICE -->
  <div class="section">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div class="sec-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2L1 21h22L12 2zm1 15h-2v-2h2v2zm0-4h-2V9h2v4z"/></svg></div>
      <div>
        <div class="sec-title" data-en>Important Traffic &amp; Planning Notice</div>
        <div class="sec-title" data-fr hidden>Avis important sur la circulation</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sec-body">
      <div class="notice" data-en>Due to ongoing construction at Montréal-Trudeau International Airport, traffic conditions can fluctuate significantly depending on the time of day and day of the week. Before departing, customers are strongly encouraged to check their estimated time of arrival using their navigation app and plan ahead accordingly. Delays when reaching airport property may range from <b>10 to 45 minutes</b> due to traffic congestion. If stopped, please inform staff that you are returning a rental vehicle, and access to the rental return area will be granted. Additional travel time is recommended.</div>
      <div class="notice" data-fr hidden>En raison des travaux de construction en cours à l'aéroport international Montréal-Trudeau, les conditions de circulation peuvent varier considérablement selon l'heure et le jour de la semaine. Avant de partir, nous encourageons fortement les clients à vérifier leur temps d'arrivée estimé à l'aide de leur application de navigation et à planifier en conséquence. Les retards pour atteindre l'aéroport peuvent varier de <b>10 à 45 minutes</b> en raison de la congestion. Si vous êtes arrêté, veuillez informer le personnel que vous retournez un véhicule de location, et l'accès à la zone de retour vous sera accordé. Un temps de déplacement supplémentaire est recommandé.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="footer">
    <div class="thanks" data-en>Thank you for choosing National</div>
    <div class="thanks" data-fr hidden>Merci d'avoir choisi National</div>
    <div class="sub">Montréal International Airport · Dorval, QC</div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
  function setLang(l){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-en]').forEach(e=>e.hidden=(l!=='en'));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-fr]').forEach(e=>e.hidden=(l!=='fr'));
    document.getElementById('b-en').classList.toggle('active',l==='en');
    document.getElementById('b-fr').classList.toggle('active',l==='fr');
    document.documentElement.lang=l;
    try{localStorage.setItem('natlang',l);}catch(e){}
  }
  (function(){
    var saved;try{saved=localStorage.getItem('natlang');}catch(e){}
    if(saved) setLang(saved);
    else if((navigator.language||'').toLowerCase().startsWith('fr')) setLang('fr');
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>
